svg.title: The Letter at Puerto Lento — 5 by 8 inch paperback wrap
svg.desc: One continuous harbor scene across the back, text-free spine, and front cover for an 82-page cream-paper paperback.

g.font-family: Avenir Next, Avenir, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

text.font-family: Didot, Palatino, Times New Roman, serif
text.tspan: A letter no one will claim.
A town that will not explain.
Ana finds an unclaimed letter at the end of a quiet
shift. Its addressee is a man nobody in Puerto Lento
will discuss. To learn why, she must follow a name, an
empty table, old letters, and a small light on the water.
Ten linked stories return to the same people and places,
giving adult A2 learners a narrative thread to follow
instead of another disconnected language exercise.

text.font-family: Snell Roundhand, Apple Chancery, Palatino, serif

g.text: Open the letter. Follow Ana into the night.
